data.one_liner: Command-line tool and encoder that sorts JSON maps by key.
data.what_it_does: Provides a CLI to sort JSON files in-place and a JsonSortedEncoder that recursively sorts map keys before encoding. It supports custom indentation and works with any JSON-serializable object.
use_when: You need to keep JSON files sorted for consistency across a team.
You want all JSON output from your Dart app to be deterministic and sorted.
You want a quick way to sort a JSON file from the command line during CI.
You need a lightweight dependency that adds no build‑time code generation.
avoid_when: You require complex custom serialization logic beyond key sorting.
You need to sort data structures that are not JSON maps (e.g., custom objects).
strengths: Works with Dart SDK 2.12+ and all platforms.
weaknesses: Only sorts map keys; does not handle custom object serialization.
No support for sorting lists or other data structures.
Limited to JSON; not a general-purpose data transformer.
